name: home-mosaic.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home-mosaic.scss — MANIFEST for the masonry project grid's VISUAL layer.
//  Split by surface into home-mosaic/ partials (imported below):
//    _section  :host + .home-portfolio-section wrapper + section title
//    _grid     .home-mosaic container + per-breakpoint min-heights
//    _item     .home-mosaic-item card + border sheen ring + hover/focus
//    _media    cover area + image + title overlay + cqw title text
//    _panel    expanding description panel + draw-text char animation
//    _burn     hover title combustion canvas + rewrite slot above the desc
//    _cta      corner-bracket CTA button
//  ALL geometry (card position/width/height/columns) is computed in JS by
//  HomeMosaic.layout() via WASM math and written as inline styles — these
//  partials own colors, hover states, card chrome, captions and transitions,
//  never layout numbers.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

@import 'home-mosaic/section';
@import 'home-mosaic/grid';
@import 'home-mosaic/item';
@import 'home-mosaic/media';
@import 'home-mosaic/panel';
@import 'home-mosaic/burn';
@import 'home-mosaic/cta';
